item.title: Ben Folds Five Celebrates 30th Anniversary of Self-Titled Debut With Reissue Featuring Unearthed Versions of Classic Tracks
item.description:
[Engaging music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're celebrating a major milestone with Ben Folds Five. The iconic band is marking the 30th anniversary of their self-titled debut album with a brand-new remastered edition, set to drop on September 4th.
[Short music transition]
Host: But that's not all - this special release, titled Ben Folds Five (30th Anniversary), also features an unreleased version of the album called Shelved First Attempt. This hidden gem has been tucked away for over 30 years, and we're getting a sneak peek with the fan-favorite track "Underground (Shelved First Attempt)".
[Short clip of "Underground (Shelved First Attempt)" plays]
Host: Ben Folds himself describes the original album as "pretty rough and tumble, mostly in a good way" and "emphatically unique". The Shelved First Attempt features earlier versions of tracks like "Underground", "Julianne", and "Philosophy", as well as some surprises like "Boxing" and "Evaporated", which later appeared on their 1997 album Whatever and Ever Amen.
[Short music transition]
Host: Speaking of Whatever and Ever Amen, that album was a commercial breakthrough for the band, peaking at number 42 on the Billboard 200 chart. And who can forget the hit single "Brick", which peaked at number 6 on the Alternative Airplay chart?
[Short clip of "Brick" plays]
Host: The Ben Folds Five (30th Anniversary) release will be available on CD, vinyl, and streaming platforms. And the best part? The band is reuniting for their first live performances together in over 13 years next year!
[Exciting music fades in]
Host: Get ready to experience Ben Folds Five like never before. Stay tuned for more updates, and mark your calendars for September 4th. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard!
[Music continues to play until the end of the podcast]
